newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH SECONDARY NBP-BILL TRADE SOARS IN MARCH.
newsitem.headline: POLISH SECONDARY NBP-BILL TRADE SOARS IN MARCH.

text.p: Secondary turnover in NBP-bills jumped 571 percent to 15.3 billion zlotys in March after bottoming out in February and secondary T-bill trade rose by 6.1 percent to 41.2 billion, the National Bank of Poland said.
It said average T-bill holdings in domestic non-financial client portfolios amounted to 8.79 billion in March and was 7.9 percent higher than February's 8.14 billion.
March was the first month when secondary T-bill and NBP-bill turnover was taken into account in awarding banks primary T-bill market dealer status for 1998.
The central bank's evaluation period runs until November.
